hadith:
Gifts - Narrated 'Abdullah bin 'Ubaidullah bin Abi Mulaika:

The sons of Suhaib, (Suhaib, who was the freed slave of Bani Jud'an) claimed that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had given two houses and one room to Suhaib. Marwan asked, "Who will testify to your claim?" They replied that Ibn 'Umar would do so. Marwan sent for Ibn 'Umar who testified that Allah's Messenger (ﷺ) had really given Suhaib two houses and a room. So, Marwan gave the verdict (in favour of Suhaib's sons), because of (Ibn 'Umar's) witness.
message: Consider how Allah creates all things—from the seeds you plant to your own creation—reminding you that true growth comes from His will alone, not your efforts. Just as the Prophet (ﷺ) honored his companions with gifts and justice prevailed through honest testimony, let this inspire you to be truthful and generous in your dealings. Seek An Noor, The Light, to illuminate your path and clarify your purpose, for faith is the guidance that transforms darkness into understanding.
name:
An Noor - النُّورُ - The Light

The name An Noor originates from the Arabic word 'Noor', which means light. It is associated with the Quranic verse that highlights Allah as the source of light in both the physical and spiritual realms. This name encourages reflection on the guidance and clarity that faith provides to individuals, illuminating their path in life.
verse:
Al-Waqi'ah - The Inevitable - 56:62-66

You already know how you were first created. Will you not then be mindful?

Have you considered what you sow?

Is it you who cause it to grow, or is it We Who do so?

If We willed, We could simply reduce this ˹harvest˺ to chaff, leaving you to lament, “We have truly suffered a ˹great˺ loss.
